title: patch_file systematic line insertion failure corrupted README.md
description: Four patch_file calls on .moeb/README.md each reported 'applied' with no error, but every hunk that added a net new line (e.g. @@ -N,1 +N,2 @@) produced the same line count (234 -> 234) instead of inserting a new line. Each call merged the new content with the following line, progressively corrupting the vcs section structure. Required 4 additional read_file_range calls and a full write_file rewrite (52157 bytes) to restore correct formatting. The normalize_hunk_counts or find_closest_context functions may be silently converting N+1 insertions into N:N replacements on LF-normalized files.
proposed_resolution: Investigate the diffy crate's behavior when applying zero-context insertion hunks to files with LF-normalized line endings. The normalize_hunk_counts or find_closest_context functions may be misinterpreting insertion-only hunks as replacements. Add a unit test that patches a small file by inserting a new line and verifies the resulting line count increases by 1.
